## Purpose
Notes item for the registered feature batch `release-readiness`. Never implemented itself and not a member. Closes when every member is done and the final pull request has merged.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-23)
- ClickHouse notuning rerun: "No new drop: reuse a valid existing database, recreate only with --force, otherwise refuse before any partial work with a message naming --force".
- Gateway options on snowflake-connector-python 5.x: "Map: insecure -> DISABLED, fail-open true -> ADVISORY, fail-open false -> ENABLED, unset -> connector default" (crl_check_mode). gateway_ca_bundle goes to extra_root_store_path on 5.x.
- Connector floor: "Keep >=3.0.0: the gateway code branches on the installed version, and the pre-5 branch is covered by unit tests with a stubbed version only".
- CI coverage of 5.x: "Move uv.lock to 5.x, so the whole suite runs on what a fresh install gets (4.x coverage ends)".
- changelog-unreleased-test-paths-20261017 finished on evidence (done).
- One benchbox-site follow-up item for the gateways page.

- site-next-breaks-silently-when-core-bundle-changes-20261119: benchbox-site work, serial by policy.
